section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex / Model Grant Agreement / AGA template used as governing structural schema for proposal writing.
Inventing call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not present in Tier 2B.
Inventing project facts (partner names, capabilities, roles, prior experience, budget figures, team sizes, equipment) not present in Tier 3.
Commencing Phase 8 activity before the budget gate (Phase 7) has passed; budget-dependent content presented as confirmed without a passing budget gate.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
Allowing a workflow or skill to become a de facto constitutional authority by expanding its scope.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions to allow progress when inputs are incomplete.
Finalising text with incomplete/contradictory/unvalidated source state without explicitly flagging the gap in the deliverable.
Using generic Horizon Europe programme knowledge as a substitute for reading Tier 1 source documents when present.
Producing Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1–4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project-specific assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

check_notes.13.1: Artifact contains no structural reference to a Grant Agreement Annex, Model Grant Agreement Annex, or AGA template as a schema authority; it is a Phase 8 review-status log keyed to proposal section IDs (excellence/impact/implementation).
check_notes.13.2: Not structurally applicable: the artifact is a review-status/revision log and asserts no call requirements, scope boundaries, or eligibility conditions. No call-constraint claims are made, so no missing Tier 2B reference can arise.
check_notes.13.3: No fabricated project facts are asserted. Partner names and in-kind person-month figures (ATK 2.5, ELTE 2.0, AgroVIR 3.0, MATE 2.4, Krumatic 1.5; fellow 30 PM) appear only inside revision-action 'reason' fields that explicitly characterise them as operator-declared assumptions and repeatedly cite §13.3 as the ground for deferral because the strengthening facts are absent from Tier 3. The artifact flags absence rather than inventing facts.
check_notes.13.4: Applicable (schema_id begins 'orch.phase8.'). Per the TAPM input boundary, only CLAUDE.md and the artifact_path were read; the artifact itself contains no budget figure used as a confirmed value. Person-month values are explicitly labelled operator-declared assumptions (e.g. 'the fellow's confirmed 30 PM' separated from 'operator-declared partner in-kind estimates'), not finalised budget-confirmed claims. No budget-dependent content is presented as confirmed within this artifact.
check_notes.13.5: Not verifiable from artifact content alone (enforced by decision-log-update skill); recorded pass. Note: the artifact durably records all 9 dispositions in revision_actions/revision_log within Tier 4, consistent with §13.5.
check_notes.13.6: Not checkable from an artifact; recorded pass. The artifact does not redefine phase, tier, or gate meanings.
check_notes.13.7: No reference to activities from a phase higher than Phase 8; no evidence of phase reordering or gate weakening. Pass.
check_notes.13.8: All three sections are marked status 'final' with data_gaps_flagged=false, yet 9 unresolved findings remain — however these are transparently and explicitly recorded in revision_actions (status 'unresolved') and revision_log (change_description 'no content change; dispositioned unresolved'), each with a stated reason. Unresolved state is explicitly flagged rather than concealed, satisfying the §13.8 flagging requirement. Pass.
check_notes.13.9: No regulatory/Tier 1 claims (participation conditions, grant agreement terms, financial regulation) are asserted; §13.3/§13.4 citations are self-referential process justifications, not substituted programme knowledge. Pass.
check_notes.13.10: Artifact is a Tier 4 orchestration-state phase output, not a Tier 5 deliverable; §13.10 traceability requirement targets Tier 5 outputs. Non-applicable; recorded pass.
check_notes.13.11: Not checkable from a phase output; recorded pass. Artifact makes no modification to Tier 1/Tier 2 sources.
check_notes.13.12: Not checkable from an artifact; recorded pass. Artifact operates under Phase 8 gate discipline and does not treat CLAUDE.md as advisory.
